_note: Generic, key-independent templates. Render actual tab by resolving each 'degree' against progressions.json's degreeOffsets + the selected key, then looking up the resulting chord in chord-library.json. This replaces the mockup's hardcoded 'Key of A' example tabs — the real app must generate all 5 sections for any of the 12 keys from these templates.

sections.label: Intro
sections.strumFeel: eighth-note palm-muted downstrokes, root note only (no full chord) per hit
sections.caption: 4 bars · palm-muted

sections.label: Verse
sections.strumFeel: same rhythm cell as intro, repeated to fill 8 bars, using the two-note power chord shape
sections.caption: 8 bars
sections.note: Locked by default in the mockups — real build should let the user lock/unlock any section, Verse is just the pre-set example.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.strumFeel: open, ringing full chord hits (not palm-muted) — the section that showcases the selected progression from progressions.json
sections.caption: Open, ringing

leadLickFormula.description: Simplified 2-note-per-string lick on the top two strings (e, B), anchored to the key root's fret position on the low-E string (independent of which string the rhythm chords actually use).
leadLickFormula.wormedExample: Key of A → r=5 → e: 5,7,5,7 / B: 5,7,5,7 (matches the original mockup exactly)

sections.label: Breakdown
sections.strumFeel: half-time, heavy quarter-note hits on the tonic two-note power chord — deliberately the heaviest, simplest section
sections.caption: Half-time, heavy
sections.note: Breakdown always renders in the Half-Time drum feel regardless of the page's selected Feel, per genre convention — confirm this is the intended behavior before building.
